Alternatively we could change the behavior of Shift to always take effect 🤔

The strings shouldn't be static. This makes them initialized only once, making it impossible to change language.
You can move them into the conditions below, and to simplify, the string can be count-agnostic, like

```suggestion
	static const String multiple_resources_text = TTR("Drag and drop to copy the file path(s) to the script.") +
```
etc.
The resource branch is the same as the files branch, it just doesn't have a "files" element. We can probably merge them, using `Array files = p_info.get("files", Array());`.

For formatting and other concerns I'd not use special symbols in this, it also makes it more confusing and hard to read
